scope: Complete-original-body prerequisite review of two Supabase originals; no SQL, infrastructure, audit or model execution.
linked_reference_caveat: Only the two original bodies were read. Detailed rule files, actual migrations, installed CLI contracts, current documentation, schemas, datasets and licenses need separate review. No source-stated security or performance guarantee is treated as independently established.

sources.workflow: Identify the actual Supabase feature and schema-management convention, inspect compatible current interfaces, make the requested local change and verify the actual query or application behavior without confusing table grants, row policies and exposed privileged interfaces.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real selected app, schema and access model, version-specific CLI or SDK and applicable docs and migration conventions are required. A hosted operation additionally needs authorized least-scope project access, while local SQL work can use a reviewed isolated Postgres instance. The original distinguishes declarative schema generation from imperative local iteration and warns that broad database credentials can exceed management-token scope.
sources.offline_assessment: Real public schema or client-code changes can be offline after choosing and reviewing the actual engine and dependencies. The default standard-library Python container cannot reproduce Supabase Auth, Data API, Storage or Postgres row-security behavior. Static policy appearance or a mocked success response cannot establish actual cross-role access control or a working hosted service.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact role grants, exposure, row ownership, mutation predicates, view and function execution privileges, secret boundaries and version-compatible migration history against actual fixture requirements. Exercise allowed and denied principals in a real isolated compatible engine and verify the requested query or app flow. No live database change, security audit execution, credential discovery or login is authorized by this source review.

sources.workflow: Select the applicable prioritized Postgres rule category for a real SQL, schema, connection, concurrency or access-control task, then use its actual detailed rule before changing and evaluating the requested behavior.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual database schema, workload and intended behavior, compatible Postgres features and the selected referenced rule files and examples are required. This original is an index, not the detailed rule implementations or proof of their speedups. A hosted Supabase account is not inherently needed for generic local Postgres work.
sources.offline_assessment: A narrowly selected rule-based SQL change or plan analysis can be offline with real public artifacts and reviewed local Postgres dependencies. The default SQLite-capable Python container is not a Postgres engine. Reading this category map cannot establish the referenced rule, measured optimization or actual row-security result.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare the exact requested semantic result before and after the change, then use workload-appropriate independent measurements and actual plans or concurrency checks for performance claims. Test access predicates against real roles when relevant. Do not equate category priority, a rewritten query string or a copied example with preserved results or empirical improvement.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
